name: gca-experiment
description: Read-only qualification harness for Global Contextual Assessment (GCA) and Recursive Differential Assessment (RDA). No runtime, no writes, no authority.

scripts.stub: node tools/build-fixtures.js && node run.js --provider stub --quality perfect --all --repeats 3 --out runs/stub-perfect
scripts.stub:drifty: node tools/build-fixtures.js && node run.js --provider stub --quality drifty --all --repeats 3 --out runs/stub-drifty
scripts.stub:sloppy: node tools/build-fixtures.js && node run.js --provider stub --quality sloppy --all --repeats 2 --out runs/stub-sloppy
scripts.stub:injective: node tools/build-fixtures.js && node run.js --provider stub --quality injective --all --repeats 3 --out runs/stub-injective
